source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Fairly little specialized monitoring actually being needed once the neurosurgical procedure itself has been fully completed for the client","B":"Careful pre-operative preparation, close post-operative neurological monitoring, and coordination with the neurosurgical team regarding any changes in status","C":"Fairly few considerations actually being unique to neurosurgical care when compared with other general types of surgical procedures","D":"A process essentially identical to the coordination needed for any general surgical procedure performed at the facility as a whole"}}
source_row.rationale: Neurosurgery care coordination includes careful pre-operative preparation, close post-operative neurological monitoring (given the potential for rapid changes in neurological status), and prompt coordination with the neurosurgical team regarding any changes, reflecting the unique urgency and complexity of neurosurgical care.
source_row.source_detail: Key Elements of Neurosurgery Care Coordination
